title: Analyzing the topology of N-linked glycans by PNGase F accessibility assay
protocol: Seed SV589 cells at 4 × 10^5 cells per 6-cm dish and culture for 2 days before harvesting.
Alternatively, harvest 90% confluent cells grown in a 15-cm dish to produce the same result.
Transfect SV589 cells with pCMV-TM4SF20-Myc expression vector and empty vector using Roche X-tremeGENE HP DNA Transfection Reagent.
Harvest cells expressing the protein of interest 16 hours post transfection.
Thaw Buffer T and add protease inhibitor tablet to prepare for cell harvesting.
Prepare collection tubes (15-mL tube) for harvest of the cells.
At room temperature (22°C), aspirate the media from cultured cells.
Rinse the cells with ice-cold PBS in the culture dishes.
Aspirate the PBS and add 1.5 mL of PBS to 6-cm dishes or 10 mL to 15-cm dishes.
Scrape the cells from the dishes into PBS using plastic cell lifters.
Combine the cell suspension from three 6-cm dishes or one 15-cm dish into a 15-mL collection tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes to pellet the cells.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 600 μL of Buffer T to the cell pellet.
Pass the mixture through a 22-Guage needle connected to a 1 mL syringe 25 times to break the cells.
Centrifuge the homogenate at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C to pellet heavy membrane fractions.
Transfer 540 μL of the supernatant to a 2-mL ultracentrifuge tube.
Ultracentrifuge the post-nuclear supernatant at 100,000 × g for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the microsome pellet with 100 μL Buffer T by pipetting with 200 μL tips.
Mix 10 to 20 times until visible membrane particles are dispersed in the buffer.
Move the resuspended microsomes to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube for easier handling.
Dilute PNGase F by 1:4 with buffer T.
Assemble four reaction conditions in reaction tubes on ice for each microsome sample.
Incubate reactions at 30°C for 45 minutes.
Cool down reactions to 4°C or on ice for approximately 5 minutes.
Preheat the sample buffer for denaturation.
Dispense 20 μL of 2× Sample Buffer in a tube/well per reaction.
Preheat the sample buffer to 95°C when the incubation is about to finish.
Quickly transfer finished reactions from step 15 to corresponding wells containing the 2× Sample Buffer.
Briefly pipette to mix the sample with Sample Buffer.
Cap or seal the tubes or wells.
Incubate samples at 95°C for 5 minutes, then at 80°C for 5 minutes.
Denature the sample for SDS-PAGE.
Inactivate PNGase F by heating at 75°C for 10 minutes.
Cool the samples on ice.
Analyze the samples with SDS-PAGE followed by Western blot.
Include a microsome sample without the protein of interest as a control for unspecific bands.
Blot for the protein of interest.
Analyze proteins known to contain N-linked glycans in the lumen as quality controls.
Use an ER luminal protein GRP94 and a membrane protein CREB3L1 for quality control purposes.
